label: External things reading on externally conditioned persistence
paraphrase: Analyst control, attribution deferred. The same receiver is present at 0 in two integer-time histories satisfying the cessation law. At 1 the protector is present and there is no inducer against the receiver in one history. In the other the protector is absent and a loss inducer occurs at 1. The receiver survives to 1 only in the protected history. Neither history supplies a strict giver at 1. The surviving received bearer has an inertial reason at 1, falsifying the productive bridge in this model.
